summary: The Grand Palace is a complex of buildings in central Bangkok, Thailand, serving as the official residence of the Kings of Siam (and later Thailand) since 1782. The king, court, and royal government were based there until 1925. Although kings Bhumibol Adulyadej (Rama IX) and Vajiralongkorn (Rama X) lived elsewhere in the Dusit Palace, the Grand Palace still hosts official events and several royal ceremonies each year, and it is one of Thailand's most popular tourist attractions.
one_line: The Grand Palace is a historic royal complex in central Bangkok, Thailand, official residence of Siamese and Thai kings since 1782.
key_facts: The Grand Palace is a complex of buildings at the heart of Bangkok, Thailand.
The Grand Palace has been the official residence of the Kings of Siam (and later Thailand) since 1782.
The king, his court, and his royal government were based on the grounds of the Grand Palace until 1925.
King Bhumibol Adulyadej (Rama IX) resided at the Chitralada Royal Villa in the Dusit Palace.
King Vajiralongkorn (Rama X) resided at the Amphorn Sathan Residential Hall in the Dusit Palace.
The Chitralada Royal Villa and the Amphorn Sathan Residential Hall are both located in the Dusit Palace.
The Grand Palace is still used for official events after the kings moved their residences.
Several royal ceremonies and state functions are held within the walls of the Grand Palace every year.
The Grand Palace is one of the most popular tourist attractions in Thailand.
